title: Piercing Frame Solo MaxMakeup #005 (맥시멀리스트 얼굴 컷 · P25 집중형 · 맥시멀리스트 · 피부톤 포셀린 · 재질 얼굴만 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 금속 구리 · 쥬얼리 JQ2 · 메이크업 CarnivalGlam)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult woman — FLAWLESS PORCELAIN PALE SKIN, a luminous fair complexion with a cool rosy undertone, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in high ponytail. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, gold and copper shimmer eyes, a glossy nude-coral lip, a bold, commanding expression — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight pieces — a big copper bar in the lobe, three smaller copper rings above it, two thick copper bars and two small copper studs up to the top; one small copper stud sits in the right ear; four thin copper bars pass through the outer half of the left eyebrow; two small copper rings pass through the left nostril and a thick copper septum ring hangs below the nose; a copper hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a copper snake-bite ring beside it and a small copper ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a copper Medusa stud sits above the lips; a copper labret stud and a small copper ring sit on the chin; three small copper studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small pearls set into the metal. All jewelry is real copper, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Jewelry: besides the piercings she wears two to three pieces of silver necklaces and chains resting on her neck and collarbones, and two to three pieces of silver hair ornaments set in her hair, all of it real, without covering her eyes, her face or her piercings.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
